script_text: Halt all plans, Taurus—the celestial bodies are aligning in ways that demand your attention right now. Venus, your ruling planet, forms a precise sextile with expansive Jupiter, both positioned in your 2nd House of Income and Values, amplifying financial potential. Meanwhile, aggressive Mars squares restrictive Saturn in your 7th House of Partnerships, indicating tension in collaborative ventures that requires careful handling. For singles, this sextile vibe attracts someone with Earth-sign stability and a knack for abundance; for those in relationships, watch for disagreements over budgeting or joint investments that could escalate if not addressed calmly. Career-wise, the Sun's trine to transformative Pluto in your 10th House of Public Status signals a day to assert your authority—propose that project or ask for the promotion you deserve, as superiors are receptive. Unexpected gift: A family member may offer financial support or a valuable item that eases your burdens. Subscribe so you don't miss tomorrow's lunar insights, which could reveal hidden opportunities.
